mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Type as conType, c1.C_Name as saContractorName, c2.C_Name as saSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saCostConsultName, c4.C_Name as ssApprovedComName, sa.Sa_Contractor_Amount as saContractorAmount, sa.Sa_Supervisor_Amount as saSupervisorAmount, sa.Sa_Cost_Consult_Amount as saCostConsultAmount, sa.Sa_Approved_Amt as saApprovedAmt, sa.Sa_Historical as saHistorical, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Inv_Settlement_Second mn left join Inv_Settlement_Apply sa on sa.Sa_Id = mn.Sa_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on sa.Sa_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on sa.Sa_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on sa.Sa_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on mn.Ss_Approved_Com = c4.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}
